description: This file contains utility functions for mapping statuses and categories to specific colors suitable for dark backgrounds, including deterministic color generation from strings and theme-based status colors.

methods.name: colorFromString(key, { saturation = 55, lightness = 55 } = {})
methods.description: Deterministically generates a pastel HSL color string from an input string, producing distinct hues suitable for different categories or statuses.

methods.name: getStatusColor(status, oc)
methods.description: Maps a given status string to a theme-specific color, with fallback to a deterministic color if no known status matches.
